dashboardDescription: Review your selected areas and follow the guide to organise your Integrated Management System.

heroDescription: Organise your Integrated Management System with clear guidance and ready-to-use templates. At your own pace, one step at a time.

chooseAreas: Choose the areas that make sense for your organisation.
clearPath: A clear path from first steps to practice.

step3Description: Download documents and adapt them to your organisation.
step4Description: Follow the guidance for each requirement, one step at a time.
noStartZero: You do not have to start from scratch.
promoDescription: Find document templates to adapt, from organisation analysis to objective planning.
